name: AgentDAM
intro: AgentDAM 是一个包含 246 个端到端网页任务的隐私基准，用于评估 AI 网页导航 Agent 是否遵守数据最小化原则：仅在完成任务确有必要时使用潜在敏感信息，并同时报告任务效用与非必要信息泄露。
build_method: 人工数据种子, LLM合成长篇用户数据, 隔离网页环境执行
metric: 隐私泄露率, 隐私表现（1-泄露率）, 任务成功率
modality: 文本, 图像, 多模态
scale: 246个任务（123个人工数据种子，每个采样2次）
build_method_en: Human data seeds, LLM-synthesized long-form user data, isolated web-environment execution
eval_feature_en: End-to-end data minimization, trajectory-level privacy judging, privacy-utility trade-off
intro_en: AgentDAM is a 246-task end-to-end privacy benchmark that tests whether web-navigation agents follow data minimization: potentially sensitive information should be used only when necessary for the task, while both task utility and unnecessary disclosure are measured.

drawio_review_note: WORDING review aligned with arXiv:2503.09780v3 §§3.1–3.4 and Appendix B.2. The corrected workflow identifies Llama-3.3-70B as the user_data synthesizer and the elbow method as selecting two outputs per human seed, yielding 246 tasks from 123 seeds. The GPT-4o CoT judge directly produces privacy labels for the full evaluation and therefore feeds the full privacy-utility metrics. The disclosed four-human review of one GPT-4o plus accessibility-tree trajectory evaluation run, with 98% agreement, is a side validation of the judge and does not carry the metric computation.
